name: Mercenary Grasping Roots
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Grasping Roots (players/ranger/mercenary/grasping_roots_merc.sval, 12 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): root 4 s (5 s). Its own mana 40, cooldown 6 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Roots hold enemies around you for 4 s and cut their armor by 25%.
